description: A company manufactures several types of products and utilizes various raw materials in the production process. The company has a specific amount of each type of raw material available. Each product requires a certain amount of each raw material for every unit produced and generates a specific amount of revenue per unit. The challenge for the company is to determine the optimal quantity of each product to produce to maximize total revenue.

M.definition: Number of different products produced by the firm

N.definition: Number of different raw materials used by the firm

Available.definition: Available amount of raw material i

Requirements.definition: Amount of raw material i required to produce one unit of product j

Prices.definition: Revenue earned from selling one unit of product j
